coords: normalised 0-1, origin top-left of the frame
note: explode.frames[j].anchors are the 2D anchor points of each labelled part in explode frame j; labels are meant to be shown on the last (fully exploded) frame. rotate anchors are informational (visible=false means occluded at that angle).

parts.name: Shroud
parts.description: The outer cover that frames the fans, channels their airflow through the heatsink and protects the board.

parts.name: Fans
parts.description: Three axial fans push cool air down through the fin stack; the middle one spins the opposite way to cut turbulence.

parts.name: Heatsink
parts.description: A dense stack of thin aluminium fins that spreads the heat over a large surface for the airflow to carry away.

parts.name: Heat Pipes
parts.description: Sealed copper pipes whose internal fluid boils at the GPU and condenses in the fins, moving heat very quickly.

parts.name: PCB (Circuit Board)
parts.description: The multi-layer printed circuit board whose copper traces connect the GPU, video memory and power circuitry.

parts.name: GPU Chip
parts.description: The graphics processor die: thousands of parallel cores that render each frame and run compute workloads.

parts.name: VRM
parts.description: Voltage regulator module: power stages and chokes that step the 12 V input down to the ~1 V the GPU core runs on.

parts.name: PCIe Connector
parts.description: The x16 edge connector that plugs into the motherboard slot for data and supplies up to 75 W.

parts.name: 8-Pin Power Connector
parts.description: Supplemental PCIe power input from the power supply, rated for up to 150 W.

parts.name: Display Ports (DP + HDMI)
parts.description: DisplayPort and HDMI outputs on the I/O bracket that carry the video signal to your monitors.
